spec.title: Prop shaft values

spec.rawSql:
WITH aft AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp                                          AS time,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_aft_thrstr_rpm" AS prop_speed,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque"        AS prop_torque,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_aft_prop_shaft_power_w"  AS shaft_power
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp                                          AS time,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_fwd_thrstr_rpm" AS prop_speed,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque"        AS prop_torque,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_fwd_prop_shaft_power_w"  AS shaft_power
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT q.*, to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(q.time) AS "Updated" FROM (
SELECT * FROM aft
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fwd
) q

spec.title: PS helm console · AFT thruster
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. Analog values are rounded to 2 decimals; units are in the signal name.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_pshelm
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN CASE l.station_selected__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 2 THEN CASE l.reg_mode_selected_thruster__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 3 THEN CASE l.prop_mode_selected_thruster__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 4 THEN CASE l.man_mode_selected_thruster__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 5 THEN arrow_cast(round((((l.thruster_lever_speed_signal__value / 327.0) - 50) * 2), 2), 'Utf8')
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'PS helm station selected', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Regeneration mode selected', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Propulsion mode selected', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (4, 'Maneuvering mode selected', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (5, 'Lever speed setting [%]', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
ORDER BY s.n

WITH supply AS (

    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  AND topic = 'marpower/500000-thrs/thrusters/thrusters-temperature-supply'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft_return AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  AND topic = 'marpower/500000-thrs/thrusters/thrusters-temperature-aft'
  AND '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_return AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  AND topic = 'marpower/500000-thrs/thrusters/thrusters-temperature-fwd'
  AND '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT q.*, to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(q.time) AS "Updated" FROM (
SELECT
  LEAST(supply.time, aft_return.time)         AS time,
  supply.temperature                          AS supply_temp,

  LEAST(supply.time, fwd_return.time)         AS time,
  supply.temperature                          AS supply_temp,
  fwd_return.temperature                      AS return_temp,
  fwd_return.temperature - supply.temperature AS delta_temp
FROM supply, fwd_return
) q

spec.title: Losses

spec.rawSql:
WITH aft_motor AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque" AS prop_torque
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_motor AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque" AS prop_torque
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft_measured AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    shear_beam_calculated__value AS randax_torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_measured AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    shear_beam_calculated__value AS randax_torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT q.*, to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(q.time) AS "Updated" FROM (
SELECT
  LEAST(aft_motor.time, aft_measured.time)                                            AS time,
  ABS(aft_motor.prop_torque)                                                           AS prop_torque,
  aft_measured.randax_torque                                                           AS randax_torque,
  (aft_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio})                                         AS ideal_prop_torque,
  (aft_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio}) - ABS(aft_motor.prop_torque)            AS thruster_loss,
  ABS(aft_motor.prop_torque) / NULLIF(aft_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio}, 0)  AS thruster_efficiency
FROM aft_motor, aft_measured

UNION ALL

SELECT
  LEAST(fwd_motor.time, fwd_measured.time)                                            AS time,
  ABS(fwd_motor.prop_torque)                                                           AS prop_torque,
  fwd_measured.randax_torque                                                           AS randax_torque,
  (fwd_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio})                                         AS ideal_prop_torque,
  (fwd_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio}) - ABS(fwd_motor.prop_torque)            AS thruster_loss,
  ABS(fwd_motor.prop_torque) / NULLIF(fwd_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio}, 0)  AS thruster_efficiency
FROM fwd_motor, fwd_measured
) q
